Nuclear downloadThe zip file. Every page, every PDF, every ebook, and the important files.

January 1990 to October 2026 · The date is taken from the filename, not from the folder it was stored in

35 years of records.
35 years of testimony.
The Witness Remains.

This timeline lists original PDF files this website already links to, where the filename itself carries a year from 1990 to 2026. The date of the folder the file was stored in is not used. No event is invented for a year that has no file. The files are not joined into one continuous story.

647 files carry such a year in the filename. The earliest is 1996.

Gaps, 1990 to 2026: 1990, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2005, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014 A gap means this pass found no linked original file whose own filename carries that year. A gap is not evidence that nothing happened, and it is not filled with testimony.

0 of these filenames carry a day after 31 October 2026. They are listed because the filename states that date. A filename date is not, by itself, the date of every event described in the file. A contemporaneous file and a later testimony are marked differently. An allegation in a file is not established by the file being listed here.

Dates already named on this site

These dates were already stated on the dated documentary chronology. They are repeated so they can be read in order. This timeline does not add a new primary document to them.

  1. 1990 to 2019. The dated documentary chronology already on this site records a gap. It did not establish a continuous primary-source chain from January 1990. This timeline does not fill that gap. The dated documentary chronology.
  2. 30 June 2019. A section 73E provider certificate is referred to on the mandates page. It was not re-opened for this timeline.
  3. 9 March 2021. The site identifies a Mercy Health letter. A Mercy file with a different date in its filename is not treated as this date.
  4. 25 and 26 May 2021. The site states that Comcare claim 1326583 was lodged and refused the next day. Files below are included only where the filename itself carries a date.
  5. 15 November 2021. Commonwealth Ombudsman complaint 2021-103546 Commonwealth Ombudsman complaint 2021-103546 is named as preserved.
  6. 14 July 2022. An OPMC and OAIC file is named. The letter is the evidence of what the office wrote.
  7. 27 March 2023. Scott Tredwell’s PID assessment is named across this site.
  8. 1 June 2023. An NDIA decision declining supported independent living is named, participant 430938559.
  9. 18 June 2023. Notification of a decision not to allocate a disclosure is named.
  10. 8 January 2024. Further correspondence on superannuation and the NDIS is named.
  11. 16 October 2024. NSW Trustee and Guardian, section 122, matter 658238, is named. No filename in this pass carried 658238.
  12. 1 October 2025 and 14 November 2025. FOI/2022/045IC files and a vehicle-disposal decision are named.
  13. 19 November 2025. LECC, CASE202512395/13KM, is named as out of jurisdiction.
  14. 20 November 2025. An NDIS plan approval is named.
  15. 20 January 2026, 15 June 2026 and 3 November 2026. Accommodation and service-failure notices, a Wyong Local Court letter, and the letter to police are named. November 2026 is after the October 2026 end of the requested window. It is named because the page already names it.

Each of those dates is already published at the dated documentary chronology. Listing it here does not make it a finding.
